findings.desc: CHK-002:adversarial:3 evidence note mismatch: intent is revalidateSignals called with duplicate file paths in anchorFiles -> partition correct; evidence command test:experience-layer-revalidation note describes derivation-side dedup (sorted/deduped/capped union), not the leaf receiving an already-duplicated anchorFiles. No smoke check exercises revalidateSignals({anchorFiles:[a,a]}, ...). In practice this cannot occur (deriveFindingSignals deduplicates), but the intent is unaddressed by the bound evidence. Consider: add a check to the leaf smoke or add a waiver noting the derivation-side dedup guarantee makes this impossible.
